Microsoft Learn documents no 400 body that carries a position (https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-xdr/advanced-hunting-errors lists position-less texts such as "'project' operator: Failed to resolve scalar expression named 'x'"). HuntingClient parses Kusto's "on line [L,C]" form and "line L, column C" (also "position"/"pos"). The test fills in {line} and {column}.
